pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.content: title: 'Webhook Signed Headers', description: 'Design for signing FaceSign webhook deliveries and verifying signatures on your server.', } Webhook Signed Headers This page describes a recommended, Stripe-style design for signing webhook deliveries and verifying them on your server. Dev currently sends unsigned webhooks; this guide is future-facing for when signatures are enabled. Header format - Header: FaceSign-Signature - Value: t={unixts},v1={hexhmacsha256(rawbody, whsec...)} - t: Unix timest

pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.heading: Header format
pages.content: Header format - Header: FaceSign-Signature - Value: t={unixts},v1={hexhmacsha256(rawbody, whsec...)} - t: Unix timestamp in seconds - v1: hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 digest Example:

pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.heading: Signing algorithm
pages.content: Signing algorithm - Compute HMACSHA256(secret=whsec..., message=rawrequestbodybytes) - Hex-encode the 32-byte digest (lowercase hex preferred) - Do not parse and re-stringify JSON; sign the exact raw bytes as sent

pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.heading: Replay protection
pages.content: Replay protection - Reject if |now - t| > 300s (configurable) - Use idempotency (event IDs) to prevent double-processing

pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.heading: Receiver verification
pages.content: Receiver verification

pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.heading: Raw body notes
pages.content: Raw body notes - Express: express.raw({ type: 'application/json' }) for this route; avoid express.json() which mutates payload - Next.js App Router: use await req.arrayBuffer() for raw bytes before verifying - Flask: request.getdata() returns raw bytes

pages.title: Webhook Signed Headers
pages.heading: Rotation & rollout
pages.content: Rotation & rollout - Secrets: whsec... stored in env/secret manager; never log or expose client-side - Rotation: dual-signing window (two v1= values) or scheduled cutover; remove old key when consumers rotate - Current Dev behavior: unsigned; verify by fetching the session via sessionId for now
